item.title: State audit cites city of Leadwood for bonus, budget issues
item.description: A state audit has concluded that city officials in Leadwood distributed more than $100,000 in improper employee bonuses at a time when municipal finances were strained and infrastructure demands, including sewer system improvements, remained unaddressed.
